description: Delivery, framing, caring for your art, and returns for original paintings and giclée prints by Bristol artist Calico Melton.
title: Shipping
lede: Please get in touch with any questions you may have via email or Instagram.
shipping:
Original artwork is packaged flat and delivered by Royal Mail. 



Prints are delivered flat or rolled depending on the best way to allow safe postage. 



Please allow 10 days for Prints to be dispatched as they are printed to order.
body:
## Framing

I recommend waiting for your artwork to arrive to order or have a piece framed. framing is sometimes available and will be described as such. 

## Caring for your painting

Hang it out of direct sunlight, away from radiators and damp. Dust it gently with a soft, dry brush.

## Returns

If a print isn't right, you can return it within 14 days of delivery for a refund. 

## Paying

Payments are taken securely by Stripe, by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. I never see your card details.

## Your details

I only use your name and address to send your order, and your email to tell you about it. I count visits to the site with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which uses no cookies and doesn't track you from site to site. 

## Something else?

[Send me a message](/contact/) and I'll get back to you.
